reason: S1 changes the public h2o_qpack_flatten_request call protocol by inserting an h2o_iovec_t protocol argument before headers. H0 still uses the S0 argument sequence, so S1 + H0 has an argument-count/type mismatch and cannot exercise the function. H0 also has no control for the new protocol value that governs :protocol emission.
evidence: H0 calls h2o_qpack_flatten_request with authority, path, headers.entries, headers.size, and datagram_flow_id after scheme.
S0 declared those same trailing parameters as authority, path, headers, num_headers, and datagram_flow_id, so S0 + H0 matched.
S1 declares authority, path, protocol, headers, num_headers, and datagram_flow_id, adding a required argument that H0 does not supply.
S1 h2o_qpack_flatten_request executes flatten_known_header_with_static_lookup(..., H2O_TOKEN_PROTOCOL, protocol) when protocol.base != NULL, introducing behavior H0 cannot select.
recommended_action: Update H0 to pass an explicit protocol h2o_iovec_t in the new argument position and expose input control that can exercise both a null protocol and non-null protocol values.
